title: Dereth Town Tour - Nanto scratch

shots.standingOrder: Crest the cascades of Blue Ghost Falls and dive straight down the falling water into the upper pool, pulling out low over the water past the torch-lit fishing hut.
shots.notes: WATER (fpv.fpv-dive). Hard-mounted FPV: a 16 m level run 17 m above the upper cascades of Blue Ghost Falls, crest over the pool's edge and a -72 deg dive down the falling water (5 m standoff, spray emitters alongside) to 3 m above the upper pool, then a pull-out south low over the water past the torch-lit bamboo fishing hut. The 0.7 m 'minClr' is a Fishing Hole marker on the water surface 3 m below the lens. shots.standingOrder: Start hidden behind the bamboo fishing hut with its four burning torches, then slide sideways until Blue Ghost Falls pours into its pool beyond the flames.
shots.notes: FLAME + WATER (classic.reveal-from-occluder).
